source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 15 exercise solved (PDF 54-56): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, comparison tables, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Farq wale sawalon ke jawab table mein hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Neurotransmitter receptors are located on;
(Neurotransmitter ke receptors kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neurotransmitters synaptic cleft paar kar ke postsynaptic membrane ke receptor proteins se jurte hain (15.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which neurotransmitter is released by all motor neurons at their synapses with skeletal muscles?
(Tamam motor neurons skeletal muscles ke saath synapse par kaun sa neurotransmitter chhorte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acetylcholine motor neurons aur skeletal muscle fibres ke darmiyan (neuromuscular junction) kaam karta hai aur muscles ko sukerta hai (15.4.2).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which part of the nervous system prepares the body during emergency?
(Nervous system ka kaun sa hissa emergency mein jism ko tayyar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sympathetic nervous system dabao (stress) mein jism ko 'larne ya bhagne' ke liye tayyar karta hai: dil tez, khoon mein glucose zyada, bronchioles chaure (15.5.3).

blocks.prompt:
4. Which of these is closest to the brain tissue?
(In mein se kaun dimagh ke tissue ke sab se qareeb hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bahar se andar: cranium (khopri), dura mater, arachnoid, pia mater. Pia mater nazuk jhilli hai jo dimagh ki satah se chipki hoti hai (15.5.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) 'Acetylcholine' neurotransmitter hai, dimagh ka ghilaf nahi, is liye sawal se mail nahi khata; ghaliban 'Dura mater' likhna tha. Jawab pia mater hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. In meninges, the cerebrospinal fluid is present between;
(Meninges mein cerebrospinal fluid kin ke darmiyan hota hai?)

options.text: Pia mater aur dimagh ya spinal cord

blocks.explanation: Arachnoid apne neeche wale cerebrospinal fluid aur dura mater ke khoon ke darmiyan rukawat hai; is ke neeche pia mater hai, is liye CSF arachnoid aur pia mater ke darmiyan hai (15.5.1).

blocks.prompt:
6. Which is NOT a function of cerebrospinal fluid?
(Cerebrospinal fluid ka kaun sa kaam NAHI hai?)

options.text: Spinal cord ki hifazat karta hai

blocks.explanation: CSF ventricles aur arachnoid ke neeche ki jagah bharta hai; dimagh aur spinal cord ko gaddi aur hifazat deta hai aur ghiza pohanchata hai (chapter se aage; chapter sirf is ka banna aur gardish batata hai). Yeh hormones nahi banata; hormones endocrine glands banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. During saltatory conduction, the nerve impulse jumps from one __________ to another.
(Saltatory conduction mein nerve impulse ek __________ se doosre tak chhalang lagata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Myelinated axons mein action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banta hai aur ek node se agle node tak chhalang lagata hai, myelin wale hisse chhor kar (15.3.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) mein 'None of Ranvier' chhapa hai; durust 'Node of Ranvier' hai. Jawab (d) hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. In a resting neuron, which of these ions has the highest permeability?
(Aaram ki halat ke neuron mein kis ion ki permeability sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aaram mein K+ apne gates se bahar risaav (leak) karta hai aur yahi RMP ki bari wajah hai (15.3.1); resting membrane K+ ke liye Na+ se kahin zyada permeable hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
9. If nerve impulses in a neuron 'a' are travelling faster than the impulses in neuron 'b', what might be the reason?
(Agar neuron 'a' mein impulses neuron 'b' se tez chal rahe hon to wajah kya ho sakti hai?)

options.text: Neuron 'a' ke andar sodium ions zyada hain

blocks.explanation: Raftar zyada hoti hai agar axon myelinated ho (saltatory conduction, 50 guna tak tez) ya us ka qutr (diameter) bara ho (15.3.2). Myelin bari wajah hai, is liye (b) jawab; box dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chapter (15.3.2) ke mutabiq option (d) bhi durust hai: mota (zyada qutr wala) axon tez impulse le jata hai. Is liye sawal ke do sahi jawab hain; (b) myelin, jo bari wajah hai (50 guna tak tez), jawab rakha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. Dorsal root of spinal nerve contains?
(Spinal nerve ki dorsal root mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dorsal root mein sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites hote hain (cell bodies dorsal root ganglia mein); ventral root mein motor axons (15.5.2).

blocks.prompt:
11. Which ions cause the presynaptic vesicles to fuse with the presynaptic membrane and release a neurotransmitter into the synaptic area?
(Kaun se ions presynaptic vesicles ko membrane se mila kar neurotransmitter synapse mein chhorwate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Action potential synaptic knob tak pohanche to calcium gates khulte hain, Ca2+ andar aata hai aur vesicles membrane se mil kar exocytosis se neurotransmitter chhorte hain (15.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
12. The most common cause of dementia is;
(Dementia (yaaddasht aur soch ki kamzori) ki sab se aam wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alzheimer's disease dimagh ki barhti hui degenerative beemari hai jo buzurgon mein dementia lati hai (15.8.5); yeh sab se aam wajah hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
13. Nociceptors are specialized receptors that detect:
(Nociceptors khaas receptors hain jo kya mehsoos karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nociceptors azad nerve endings hain jo dard mehsoos karte hain (15.6.3).

blocks.prompt:
14. Which receptor detects deep pressure and vibration?
(Kaun sa receptor gehra dabao aur thartharahat (vibration) mehsoos karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pacinian corpuscles skin mein gehre hain aur gehra dabao aur vibration mehsoos karte hain; Meissner's halka chhoona, Merkel cells halka chhoona, Ruffini endings lagatar dabao aur khinchao (15.6.3).

blocks.prompt:
15. Which of the following is a narcotic drug used for pain relief?
(In mein se kaun si narcotic dawa dard door karne ke liye istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Narcotic aik opioid dawa hai jo dard door karti hai aur aadat ka bara khatra rakhti hai, maslan morphine, codeine, oxycodone; caffeine, alcohol aur nicotine psychoactive hain magar narcotics nahi (15.7).

blocks.prompt:
16. Withdrawal symptoms of drug abuse include:
(Nasha chhorne ki alamaat (withdrawal symptoms) mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Withdrawal alamaat: pareshani, udasi, thakan, sar dard, paseena, matli, neend na aana, kapkapi aur daure (15.7.2).

blocks.prompt:
17. Caffeine increases alertness by:
(Caffeine chusti (alertness) kaise barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Caffeine adenosine ka asar rokta hai, jo neend aur sukoon laata hai; is liye chusti aur energy barhti hai (15.7.1).

blocks.prompt:
1. Enlist the basic elements of nervous coordination.
Nervous coordination ke bunyadi elements ki fehrist banayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Receptors: stimuli mehsoos kar ke sensory neurons mein impulse shuru karte hain.
2. Central nervous system (dimagh aur spinal cord, inter-neurons): control centre jo khabar par amal (process) karta hai.
3. Effectors (muscles aur glands): motor neurons ke laye impulses par jawab dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Define receptors and effectors with examples.
Receptors aur effectors ki misalon ke saath tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Receptors: woh organs, tissues ya cells jo stimuli (bahar ya andar ki tabdeeli) mehsoos kar ke sensory neurons mein nerve impulse banate hain, maslan aankh, kaan, skin, taste buds.
Effectors: woh hisse jo CNS se motor neurons ke zariye aane wale impulse par jawab dete hain: muscles (sukarte hain) aur glands (ratoobat chhorte hain), maslan quadriceps muscle, salivary glands.

blocks.prompt:
3. State the path of a message transmitted through the nervous system.
Nervous system mein paigham (message) ka raasta bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Stimulus -> receptor -> sensory neuron -> central nervous system (inter-neurons) -> motor neuron -> effector -> jawab (response). Is raaste mein neurons kaam ki ikaai hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Define nerve impulse.
Nerve impulse ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Nerve impulse electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar hai jo neuron ki lambai mein chalti hai; yeh action potential hai jo axon par ek hisse se agle hisse mein dobara banta jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Name the factors responsible for the resting membrane potential of neuron.
Neuron ke resting membrane potential ke zimmedar factors ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Fixed anions: cell ke andar bare manfi (negative) proteins aur nucleic acids jo bahar nahi nikal sakte.
2. Sodium-potassium pump: ATP laga kar har 2 K+ andar ke badle 3 Na+ bahar.
3. K+ ka K+ gates se bahar risaav (leak).
Nateeja: andar taqreeban -70 mV.

blocks.prompt:
6. What are the main components of the nervous system?
Nervous system ke bunyadi hisse kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Central nervous system (CNS): dimagh aur spinal cord.
2. Peripheral nervous system (PNS): 12 joron cranial aur 31 joron spinal nerves aur ganglia, jo sensory aur motor raaste banate hain; motor raaste ke somatic aur autonomic (sympathetic aur parasympathetic) systems.

blocks.prompt:
7. Define narcotic drugs and give examples.
Narcotic drugs ki tareef karein aur misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Narcotic drug aik opioid dawa hai jo dard door karne ke liye istemal hoti hai aur jis ki aadat (addiction) aur ghalat istemal ka bara khatra hai. Misalein: morphine, codeine, oxycodone (heroin bhi afeem ke paude se bana opioid hai).

blocks.prompt:
8. Briefly describe the effects of drug addiction and tolerance on the functioning of nervous system.
Drug addiction aur tolerance ke nervous system ke kaam par asraat mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nasha aawar drugs dimagh ke khushi aur shauq (motivation) wale hisson par asar karte hain: dopamine nikalwate hain aur us ka wapas jazb hona rokte hain, is liye synaptic cleft mein dopamine jama ho jata hai.
Dimagh postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam kar deta hai: yeh tolerance hai, aur wahi khushi ke liye zyada dose chahiye.
Drug band ho to normal dopamine kam receptors ko kam uksata hai; withdrawal alamaat aur shadeed talab (addiction) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. State the causes, symptoms and treatment of stroke and meningitis.
Stroke aur meningitis ki wajoohaat, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Stroke (khoon ki naali band ya phatne se dimagh ke hisse ko khoon na milne ka nuqsan): wajoohaat: high blood pressure, sigrat noshi, diabetes, zyada cholesterol, motapa, khandani tareekh. Alamaat: jism ke mukhalif hisse ka falij, aphasia (bolne se qasir), achanak dekhne ya chalne mein mushkil, chakkar, shadeed sar dard. Ilaj: khoon patla karne, lothra ghulane ya BP ki dawaiyan, operation, bahaali (rehabilitation).
Meningitis (meninges ki sozish): wajoohaat: bacterial (sab se khatarnak), viral, fungal, parasitic infection. Alamaat: gardan akarna, sar dard, bukhar; shadeed mein falij ya behoshi (coma). Ilaj: antibiotics, antivirals ya antifungals; kuch bacterial qismon ke liye vaccines.

blocks.prompt:
10. State the causes, symptoms and treatment of brain tumor.
Brain tumour ki wajoohaat, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Brain tumour dimagh mein cells ka ghair mamooli gucha (glial cells ya neurons se), benign (be-zarar) ya malignant (cancer).
Wajoohaat: asal wajah na-maloom; khatre: radiation, khandani tareekh, kuch genetic mutations.
Alamaat (jagah ke mutabiq): sar dard, shadeed nerve dard, falij, daure, coma.
Ilaj: operation, radiation therapy, chemotherapy.

blocks.prompt:
11. State the causes, symptoms and treatment of Alzheimer disease.
Alzheimer ki beemari ki wajoohaat, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Alzheimer's disease dimagh ki barhti hui degenerative beemari hai jo yaaddasht, soch aur rawaiye ko mutasir karti hai; buzurgon mein dementia lati hai.
Wajoohaat: genetic, mahauli aur tarz-e-zindagi ke factors ka majmooa.
Alamaat: halki bhool aur uljhan se shuru ho kar zuban, masle hal karne aur roz ke kaam mein mushkil tak.
Ilaj: koi shifa nahi; dawaiyan beemari ki raftar dheemi aur yaaddasht behtar karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the structure of a neuron.
Neuron ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Neuron (nerve cell) nervous system ki banawat aur kaam ki ikaai hai. Har neuron ke teen bunyadi hisse:
1. Cell body: phoola hua hissa jis mein nucleus aur zyada tar organelles hain; cytoplasm mein Nissl's granules (ribosomes aur rough ER ke guchhe) protein banane ke liye.
2. Dendrites: cell body ki membrane wali shaakhein jo doosre neurons ya cells se khabar le kar impulse banati aur cell body ki taraf le jati hain. Motor aur inter-neurons kai jagahon se khabar lete hain, is liye un ke dendrites bohat shaakhdar hain.
3. Axon: lambi membrane wali shaakh jo impulse cell body se door le jati hai; ek ya shaakhdar (kuch ek meter se bhi lambe). Is ka sira, axon terminal, muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se milta hai.
Myelin sheath: kai neurons mein glial cells axon ke gird membrane ki tahein lapet-te hain: PNS mein Schwann cells, CNS mein oligodendrocytes. Yeh insulation impulse tez karti hai. Har 1-2 mm par khala (gaps) hote hain jinhein nodes of Ranvier kehte hain. Sheath wale neurons myelinated, baghair sheath non-myelinated.
Neuroglia (glial cells) neurons ki madad karte hain: ghiza dete, fazle hatate aur hifazat (immunity) dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the function of the three types of neurons with the help of a reflex arc.
Reflex arc ki madad se teen qisam ke neurons ka kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Neurons ki qismein:
1. Sensory neurons: receptors se CNS tak impulse; unipolar, cell bodies CNS se bahar ganglia mein.
2. Inter-neurons (associative): poore CNS ke andar; sensory ya doosre inter-neurons se impulse le kar motor ya doosre inter-neurons ko dete hain; khabar par amal karte hain.
3. Motor neurons: CNS se effectors tak impulse; multipolar, cell bodies CNS mein.
Reflex arc: sab se saada neural raasta; reflex action (fauri, khud ba khud, ghair ikhtiyari jawab) ko control karta hai.
Knee-jerk reflex:
1. Stimulus: ghutne ke neeche patellar tendon par hathori se thapki.
2. Quadriceps muscle ka receptor khinchao mehsoos kar ke sensory neuron mein impulse shuru karta hai.
3. Sensory neuron isay spinal cord tak le ja kar seedha motor neuron ko deta hai (is raaste mein inter-neuron nahi).
4. Motor neuron isay effector yani quadriceps tak le jata hai jo sukarta hai; neeche ki taang aage ko uchhalti hai.
5. Saath hi sensory neuron spinal cord ke ek inter-neuron ko active karta hai jo hamstrings ke motor neurons ko rokta hai, is liye hamstrings dheele rehte hain.
Yun sensory neurons mehsoos karte, inter-neurons tarteeb dete (aur mukhalif muscles ko rokte), aur motor neurons jawab paida karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Describe the generation and transmission of nerve impulse.
Nerve impulse ke banne aur aage barhne ka bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nerve impulse neuron par electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar hai.
1. Resting membrane potential (RMP): aaram wala neuron polarized hai, andar manfi aur bahar musbat, taqreeban -70 mV. Wajah: (a) andar fixed anions (proteins, nucleic acids); (b) Na-K pump ATP laga kar har 2 K+ andar ke badle 3 Na+ bahar karta hai (K+ andar 30 guna, Na+ bahar 10 guna zyada); (c) K+ ka gates se bahar risaav.
2. Banna (action potential): stimulus par ek hisse ki polarity ulat jati hai.
a. Depolarization: Na+ gates khulte, Na+ tezi se andar; potential -70 mV se zero aur phir taqreeban +50 mV, taqreeban ek millisecond ke liye.
b. Repolarization: Na+ gates band, K+ gates khule, K+ bahar; andar phir manfi.
c. Hyperpolarization: potential thori der RMP se bhi neeche (K+ gates der se band); refractory period.
d. RMP par wapsi: Na-K pump ions ki tarteeb bahal karta hai (-70 mV).
3. Aage barhna (propagation): impulse safar nahi karta balke dobara banta hai: ek hisse ka action potential agle hisse ko depolarize karta hai jo apna action potential banata hai, jabke pichhla hissa repolarize hota hai. Axon par taqat (amplitude) barabar rehti hai.
4. Raftar: mote (zyada qutr) aur myelinated axons mein zyada. Myelinated axons mein action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banta aur node se node chhalang lagata hai (saltatory conduction), 120 m/s tak; non-myelinated mein 1-3 m/s.
5. Axon terminal par impulse neurotransmitters ke zariye synapse paar kar ke agle cell tak jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe polarization, depolarization and hyperpolarisation of neuron membrane.
Neuron membrane ki polarization, depolarization aur hyperpolarisation bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Polarization (aaram ki halat): aaram wale neuron mein andar manfi aur bahar musbat charge; yeh resting membrane potential taqreeban -70 mV hai. Wajah: andar fixed anions, Na-K pump (3 Na+ bahar, 2 K+ andar, ATP se) aur K+ ka gates se bahar risaav.
2. Depolarization: stimulus par Na+ gates khulte hain aur Na+ tezi se andar aata hai. Andar ka manfi charge kam hota hai; potential -70 mV se zero aur phir taqreeban +50 mV. Polarity ka yeh ulat jana chhote hisse par taqreeban ek millisecond ke liye action potential banata hai.
(Phir repolarization: Na+ gates band, K+ gates khule, K+ bahar aur andar phir manfi.)
3. Hyperpolarization: repolarization potential ko thori der RMP se bhi zyada manfi le jati hai kyun ke kuch K+ gates der se band hote hain. Is refractory period mein neuron aasani se naya action potential nahi bana sakta (chapter ki Book correction: aam se taqatwar stimulus bana sakta hai). Phir Na-K pump -70 mV RMP bahal karta hai.
Inhibitory synapse par bhi hyperpolarization hoti hai jab Cl- channels khul kar Cl- andar aata hai aur andar RMP se zyada manfi ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan yaad: polarization = aaram (-70), depolarization = ulat jana (+50 tak), repolarization = wapas manfi, hyperpolarization = had se zyada manfi (-70 se neeche), phir pump se -70 par wapsi.

blocks.prompt:
5. Describe the saltatory conduction of nerve impulse.
Nerve impulse ki saltatory conduction bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Myelinated neurons mein axon par myelin sheath (PNS mein Schwann cells, CNS mein oligodendrocytes) lipti hoti hai, jo insulation hai.
2. Har 1-2 mm par sheath mein khali jagah (non-myelinated) hoti hai: nodes of Ranvier.
3. Myelin ke neeche ions membrane paar nahi kar sakte, is liye action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banta hai.
4. Ek node ka action potential agle node ko depolarize karta hai, yun impulse node se node chhalang lagata hai aur myelin wale hisse chhor deta hai. Isi chhalang ko saltatory conduction kehte hain (Latin saltare = chhalang lagana; chapter se aage).
5. Yeh sab se tez non-myelinated axons se bhi 50 guna tak tez hai: myelinated 120 m/s tak, non-myelinated 1-3 m/s.
6. Kam hisse fire karte hain, is liye energy bhi bachti hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the structure of synapse.
Synapse ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Synapse ek neuron ke axon terminal aur doosre neuron ke dendrites ya effector cell (muscle ya gland) ke darmiyan jor hai. Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ka synapse neuromuscular junction kehlata hai.
Hisse:
1. Presynaptic neuron: woh neuron jis ka axon action potential synapse ki taraf laata hai. Is ke axon terminal par kai synaptic knobs hain jin mein neurotransmitter se bhare bohat se synaptic vesicles hain. Presynaptic membrane mein calcium gates hain.
2. Synaptic cleft: dono cells aapas mein nahi chhoote; beech mein maaye se bhari khali jagah hai.
3. Postsynaptic neuron ya cell: doosri taraf ka neuron ya cell; is ki postsynaptic membrane par neurotransmitter ke receptor proteins aur Na+ (ya Cl-) gates hain.

blocks.prompt:
7. Explain synaptic transmission of nerve impulse.
Nerve impulse ki synaptic transmission bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Synaptic transmission action potential ki khabar ka synapse paar karna hai, kimiyai neurotransmitters ke zariye:
1. Action potential synaptic knobs tak pohanchta hai; presynaptic membrane ke calcium gates khulte hain.
2. Synaptic cleft ke Ca2+ ions tezi se presynaptic axon mein aate hain.
3. Ca2+ ki wajah se synaptic vesicles presynaptic membrane se milte aur exocytosis se neurotransmitter cleft mein chhorte hain.
4. Neurotransmitter cleft paar kar ke postsynaptic membrane ke receptor proteins se jurta hai.
5. Jurna paigham hai: postsynaptic membrane ke Na+ gates khulte aur action potential banta hai (excitatory). Inhibitory neurotransmitter Cl- channels khol kar hyperpolarize karta hai.
6. Neurotransmitter cleft mein nahi rehta: kai synapses par presynaptic neuron isay wapas jazb kar leta hai, kuch par enzymes isay tor dete hain (maslan acetylcholinesterase acetylcholine ko).
Presynaptic action potentials jitne zyada, utna zyada neurotransmitter nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Classify neurotransmitters as inhibitory and excitatory and list some common examples.
Neurotransmitters ko inhibitory aur excitatory mein taqseem karein aur aam misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Excitatory neurotransmitters: postsynaptic neuron ki Na+ permeability barha kar action potential banate hain. Misalein:
- Acetylcholine: motor neurons aur skeletal muscle fibres ke darmiyan, aur bohat se neurons ke darmiyan.
- Glutamate: CNS mein.
- Biogenic amines (hormones bhi): norepinephrine (CNS aur sympathetic nerves; neend, tawajjuh, chusti); epinephrine (adrenal glands aur brainstem; chusti); dopamine (dimagh; jism ki harkat, shauq aur khushi; is ki kami se Parkinson ki kapkapi); serotonin (90% aanton ke neurons, 10% CNS; bhook, neend, yaaddasht, mizaaj; kami se depression).
2. Inhibitory neurotransmitters: postsynaptic neuron mein impulse ka imkaan kam karte hain; Na+ ke bajaye Cl- channels kholte hain, Cl- andar aata hai aur andar RMP se zyada manfi (hyperpolarization). Misalein:
- GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid): CNS ka bara inhibitory neurotransmitter; bechaini, dabao aur khauf kam, sukoon aur neend (sedatives is ka asar barhate hain).
- Glycine: spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein.
- Endorphins: dard ke paigham wale excitatory neurotransmitters kam kar ke dard rokte hain (morphine aur heroin inhi ki naqal karte hain).

blocks.prompt:
9. Explain briefly the functions of major parts of brain.
Dimagh ke bare hisson ke kaam mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Cerebrum (sab se bara; do hemispheres corpus callosum se jure; har ek jism ke mukhalif hisse ko control karta hai):
- Frontal lobes: zabt-e-nafs, mansooba bandi, dalail, mujarrad soch.
- Parietal lobes: hissi (sensory) khabar, jism ki position ka ehsas, tawajjuh, harkat ka mansooba aur amal.
- Temporal lobes: dekhi cheezon ki yaad, zuban samajhna, jazbat; auditory cortex (aawaz).
- Occipital lobes: dekhna (visual cortex).
- Cerebral cortex: motor areas (ikhtiyari muscles), sensory areas, association areas (aala zehni kaam; zuban baayen, visual-spatial salahiyat daayen).
2. Brainstem: midbrain dekhne aur sunne ki khabar aage bhejta hai (reticular formation); pons cerebrum aur cerebellum ke darmiyan impulses; medulla oblongata dil ki dharkan, saans aur doosre homeostatic kaamon ka relay aur control centre.
3. Diencephalon: thalamus hissi khabar cerebrum tak pohanchata hai; hypothalamus temperature, bhook, ser hona, pyaas aur jazbat control karta aur pituitary gland ko chalata hai.
4. Limbic system: amygdala (jazbat: mohabbat, nafrat, ghussa, khauf); hippocampus (thori der ki yaad ko lambi yaad banana).
5. Cerebellum: muscles ke kaam ki tarteeb, jism ki halat (posture), tawazun aur tez musalsal harkat.

blocks.prompt:
10. Describe the structure of human brain and compare it with that of spinal cord.
Insani dimagh ki banawat bayan karein aur spinal cord se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dimagh ki banawat: khopri (cranium) mein band, teen meninges (dura mater, arachnoid, pia mater) se dhaka, arachnoid ke neeche CSF. Wazan taqreeban 1.4 kg (jism ka 2%), taqreeban 100 arab inter-neurons. Bare hisse:
1. Cerebrum: sab se bara; bahar ki satah bohat tahdar (gyri, sulci, fissures); gehri daraar se baayen aur daayen hemisphere, jo corpus callosum se jure; har hemisphere mein frontal, parietal, temporal aur occipital lobes. Bahar cerebral cortex grey matter (motor, sensory, association areas), neeche white matter.
2. Brainstem: midbrain, pons aur medulla oblongata; cerebrum ko spinal cord se jorta hai.
3. Diencephalon: thalamus aur hypothalamus, beech mein gehre; dono thalamus ke milap par pineal gland; thalamus ke gird limbic system (hypothalamus, amygdala, hippocampus).
4. Cerebellum: cerebrum ke neeche aur peechhe; tahdar cortex, neeche white matter.
5. Ventricles: chaar maaye se bhari khali jagahein (do lateral cerebrum mein, teesra diencephalon mein, chautha cerebellum aur brainstem ke darmiyan, spinal cord ki central canal se jura) jo CSF banati aur ghumati hain.
Spinal cord: medulla se reerh ki haddi ke andar neeche jati neurons ki tar, meninges se dhaki; 0.25-0.5 inch chauri, cervical aur lumbar hisson mein zyada; andar H jaisa grey matter aur central canal, bahar white matter; is se 31 joron spinal nerves nikalti hain.

rows: Grey matter bahar (cortex), white matter andar
Grey matter andar (H jaisa), white matter bahar
Ek central canal (chauthe ventricle ka tasalsul)
Aala kaam: soch, yaad, hawas, tarteeb, homeostasis
Jism aur dimagh ke darmiyan shahrah; reflex centre

blocks.prompt:
11. Explain the types and functions of autonomic nervous system.
Autonomic nervous system ki qismein aur kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Autonomic nervous system spinal aur cranial nerves ke un motor neurons se bana hai jo smooth muscles aur glands ko control karte hain. Yeh ghair ikhtiyari hai aur andaruni halaat jaise saans, dil ki dharkan aur hazma control karta hai. Do hisse:
1. Sympathetic nervous system: jismani ya jazbati dabao mein jism ko 'larne ya bhagne' ke liye tayyar karta hai. Is ke motor neurons spinal cord ke thoracic aur lumbar hisson se nikal kar andaruni aaza tak jate hain. Asar: dil tez aur zor se, khoon mein glucose zyada, khoon muscles aur dil ki taraf, bronchioles aur putliyan chauri, hazma sust.
2. Parasympathetic nervous system: khatra talne ke baad sympathetic ka ulat kaam kar ke aaza ko normal karta hai. Is ke motor neurons dimagh aur spinal cord ke sacral hisse se nikalte hain; bohat se vagus (daswein cranial) nerve mein. Asar: dil dheema, hazme ki ratoobat aur harkat zyada, putliyan aur bronchioles tang.

rows: Khoon ki naliyan: muscles mein chauri, skin mein tang
Muscles aur skin ki naliyan: koi asar nahi

blocks.prompt:
12. Write a detailed note on the receptors for smell.
Soonghne ke receptors par tafseeli note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Soonghna (olfaction) naak ki khali jagahon (nasal cavities) ke oopri hisse ke chemoreceptors se hota hai.
2. Yeh receptors sensory neurons ke sire hain jo patli teh nasal (olfactory) epithelium mein hain.
3. Neurons supporting cells (hifazat) aur basal cells (stem cells jo purane neurons ki jagah naye banate hain) ke darmiyan ghane hain.
4. Un ke dendrites par baal jaise nanhe cilia hain jo naak ki nam balgham (mucus) mein nikle hote hain.
5. Hawa ke kimiyai maadde mucus mein hal ho kar cilia ke khaas receptor sites se jurte hain.
6. Jurne se sensory neurons mein nerve impulse banta hai jo olfactory nerves (cranial nerve I) se olfactory bulb tak jata hai, aur wahan boo ka ehsas banta hai.
7. Boo zaiqe mein bhi hissa leti hai: naak band kar ke pyaaz ka zaiqa badal jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
13. Explain the structure of the receptors for taste.
Zaiqe ke receptors ki banawat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Zaiqa khaas chemoreceptors, taste buds, se mehsoos hota hai; taqreeban 10,000.
2. Zyada tar zuban ke ubharon (papillae) ke darmiyan dhanse hain; kuch gale aur munh ki chhat par.
3. Taste bud gathli (bulb) jaisa hai: baal jaise hisson wale receptor cells, aur basal cells jo naye receptor cells banate hain.
4. Yeh taste pore (sooraakh) ke zariye munh mein khulta hai.
5. Khane ya peene ke kimiyai maadde receptor cells ko uksate hain; sensory neurons mein impulse banta hai jo cranial nerves VII, IX aur X se brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak jata hai, jahan boo aur banawat (texture) ke saath mil kar zaiqa banta hai.
6. Kitab chaar qismein (namkeen, meetha, khatta, kadwa) zuban ke hisson mein batati hai: meetha nok par, khatta kinaron par, kadwa peechhe, namkeen zyada tar satah par. (Chapter ki Book correction: har zaiqe ke receptors zuban ke har hisse mein hain, aur umami paanchwan zaiqa hai.)

blocks.prompt:
14. Describe the receptors for touch and pain.
Chhoone aur dard ke receptors bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cutaneous receptors (skin ke receptors) chhoone, dabao, garmi, sardi aur dard par jawab dete hain.
A. Dard ke receptors (nociceptors): poore jism mein, khaas kar satah ke qareeb, azad nerve endings. Dard woh stimulus hai jo tissue ko nuqsan de ya dene wala ho. Mukhtalif nociceptors shadeed temperature, bohat zor ke dabao ya khaas kimiyai maaddon (kuch zakhmi cells se nikalne wale) par jawab dete hain.
B. Chhoone ke receptors (mechanoreceptors):
1. Meissner's corpuscles: oopri skin (hont, ungliyon ke pore, hatheli, talwe) mein ghilaf wale sensory nerve endings; halka chhoona aur vibration.
2. Hair follicle receptors: baalon ki jar ke gird nerve endings; baalon ki harkat.
3. Merkel cells: epidermis ki sab se gehri teh mein bezawi (oval) receptors (ungliyon ke pore); halka chhoona.
4. Pacinian corpuscles: skin mein gehre ghilaf wale endings; gehra dabao aur vibration.
5. Ruffini endings: dermis mein ghilaf wale endings; lagatar dabao aur khinchao.
Impulses sensory neurons se spinal cord aur dimagh tak jate hain jahan ehsas banta hai. (Skin mein thermoreceptors bhi hain: sardi aur garmi ke liye nange dendrite endings.)

blocks.prompt:
15. Describe the use and abuse of narcotic drugs with examples.
Narcotic drugs ka istemal aur ghalat istemal misalon ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Narcotic aik opioid dawa hai jo dard door karti hai aur jis ki aadat aur ghalat istemal ka bara khatra hai, maslan morphine, codeine, oxycodone; heroin afeem ke paude se bana opioid hai. Tamam narcotics psychoactive hain (dimagh, mizaaj, idraak aur rawaiye ko badalte hain).
Istemal (use): doctor ke kehne par munasib tibbi istemal. Afeem se bane maadde (morphine) dard kush (analgesic) hain kyun ke yeh endorphins jaise hain aur un ke receptors se jur kar dard ke signal rokte hain; maslan shadeed dard mein morphine.
Ghalat istemal (abuse): psychoactive drugs ka na-munasib, ghair tibbi istemal.
1. Heroin: bohat nasha aawar opioid, injection, dhuan ya naak se; jhooti khushi aur sukoon; jaldi inhisar aur aadat; saans ka dabna, infections aur zehni beemariyan.
2. Doosre ghalat istemal hone wale drugs: cannabis (charas, bhang; soch ki kamzori, saans aur zehni masail), nicotine, alcohol (jigar aur dil ki beemari), inhalants (gond, nail polish remover; aasabi nuqsan).
Asraat: inhisar, aadat, tolerance (dose barhti jati hai) aur withdrawal alamaat (bechaini, udasi, sar dard, paseena, matli, be-khwabi, kapkapi, wahm (hallucinations), daure).

blocks.prompt:
16. What is meant by drug addiction and drug tolerance? Explain with reference to caffeine and nicotine.
Drug addiction aur drug tolerance se kya murad hai? Caffeine aur nicotine ke hawale se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Drug addiction: nuqsan ke bawajood drug ki be-qaboo talab aur istemal ki beemari; yeh inhisar (dependence: kaam chalane ke liye jismani ya jazbati tor par drug par bharosa) se paida hoti hai.
Drug tolerance: lagatar istemal se jism aadi aur kam hassas ho jata hai, wahi asar ke liye zyada dose chahiye; is se addiction barhta hai. Drug chhorne par withdrawal alamaat.
Aasabi wajah: drug dopamine nikalwata aur us ka wapas jazb hona rokta hai; dopamine jama hota hai; dimagh dopamine receptors kam kar deta hai (tolerance); drug ke baghair kam receptors kam uksaye jate hain (withdrawal).
Caffeine (coffee, chai, energy drinks): adenosine ko rokta hai jo neend aur sukoon laata hai, is liye chusti aur energy barhti hai. Roz istemal se tolerance (wahi chusti ke liye zyada); achanak chhorne par sar dard aur thakan.
Nicotine (sigrat, cigar, chabane wala tambaku): bohat nasha aawar stimulant; dimagh ke nicotine receptors se jur kar dopamine aur doosre neurotransmitters nikalwata hai aur khushi deta hai. Roz istemal se tolerance; chhorne par chirchirapan, bechaini aur shadeed talab. Lambe istemal se cancer, dil ki beemari aur saans ke masail ka khatra.

blocks.prompt:
17. Explain the classification of nervous disorders with examples.
Nervous disorders ki darja bandi misalon ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Vascular disorders: dimagh aur spinal cord ki khoon ki naliyan mutasir. Misalein: stroke (dimagh ki naali band ya phatna; ischemic, haemorrhagic, transient ischemic attack) aur cerebral venous thrombosis.
2. Infectious disorders: CNS ka viruses, bacteria, fungi, protozoa ya flatworms se infection. Misal: meningitis (meninges ki sozish; gardan akarna, sar dard, bukhar).
3. Structural disorders: nervous system ki jismani banawat mein kharabi ya nuqsan. Misalein: brain tumour, spinal cord ki chot.
4. Functional disorders: koi zahiri banawati wajah na ho phir bhi kaam mein kharabi. Misal: sar dard (primary: migraine, tension; secondary: khoon behna, tumour, meningitis ki wajah se).
5. Degenerative disorders: dimagh, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke cells ka dheere dheere kharab hona. Misalein: Parkinson's disease (dopamine neurons ka khatma; harkat ke masail), Huntington's disease, multiple sclerosis (immune system myelin ko nuqsan deta hai), Alzheimer's disease (dementia).

blocks.prompt:
18. Explain the principles and use of EEG, CT scan and MRI.
EEG, CT scan aur MRI ke usool aur istemal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Electroencephalography (EEG):
Usool: neurons ke darmiyan chalne wale bijli ke nerve impulses, yani dimagh ki bijli ki sargarmi, pakarna.
Tareeqa: sar ki jild (scalp) par dhaat ke electrodes amplifier se jure hote hain; signals bare kar ke screen ya kaghaz par lehron (gamma, beta, alpha, theta, delta) ki shakal mein likhe jate hain.
Istemal: daure (seizures), mirgi (epilepsy) aur brain tumour ki jaanch; dard nahi, behoshi ki dawa nahi.
2. Computed tomography (CT scan):
Usool: mukhtalif tissues X-rays ko mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain; isi farq se tasveer banti hai.
Tareeqa: mareez motor wali mez par let kar doughnut jaisi gantry mein jata hai; X-ray tube us ke gird ghoomti hai; samne ke detectors jazb shuda shuaon ko record karte hain; computer tafseeli aar-paar (cross-sectional) tasveerein banata hai.
Istemal: naram tissues (dimagh, phephre, pet) aur haddiyon ki kharabi ki tasveer; cancer, infection aur chot ki tashkhees.
3. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI):
Usool: tissues mein hydrogen atoms ki miqdaar mukhtalif hai aur hydrogen atoms magnetic hain.
Tareeqa: mareez taqatwar magnet wale tube jaise scanner mein jata hai; radio waves hydrogen atoms se signal nikalwati hain jinhein receiver pakarta hai; computer tafseeli teen-rukhi (3D) tasveerein banata hai.
Istemal: naram tissues (dimagh, spinal cord, andaruni aaza), khoon ki naliyon ki kharabi aur kuch tumours ki tasveer.

blocks.prompt:
1. Predict from every day experience what various kinds of receptor can be found in human body.
Rozmarra ke tajurbe se andaza lagayein ke insani jism mein kaun kaun se receptors hain.
blocks.explanation:
Rozmarra ke tajurbe se har qisam ke stimulus ke receptors ka andaza:
1. Roshni aur rang dekhna: photoreceptors, retina ke rod aur cone cells.
2. Aawaz sunna aur tawazun: kaan ke receptors.
3. Khane ka zaiqa: chemoreceptors, zuban ke taste buds.
4. Soonghna: naak ke chemoreceptors (olfactory neurons).
5. Halka chhoona, gehra dabao, vibration, baalon ki harkat ya skin ka khinchao: mechanoreceptors (Meissner's corpuscles, Merkel cells, Pacinian corpuscles, Ruffini endings, hair follicle receptors).
6. Garmi aur sardi: skin ke thermoreceptors.
7. Jalne, katne ya chutki ka dard: nociceptors.
8. Andaruni: hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors (jism ka temperature), hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors (pyaas), khoon ki naliyon ke receptors (blood pressure), muscles ke stretch receptors (knee-jerk).
Chapter se aage: muscles aur jorron ke proprioceptors aankhein band hon to bhi baazu-taangon ki position batate hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Conceptualize the electrical activity of brain, which can be recorded using magnets and tomography.
Dimagh ki bijli ki sargarmi ka tasawwur bayan karein jo magnets aur tomography se record ki ja sakti hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Dimagh ki bijli ki sargarmi us ke arbon neurons ke darmiyan aur synapses ke paar chalne wale nerve impulses (action potentials) hain; bohat se neurons ki mili juli sargarmi lehrein banati hai.
2. EEG yeh sargarmi seedha record karta hai: scalp ke electrodes aur amplifier lehrein dikhate hain jo dimagh ki halat ke saath badalti hain: gamma (tez idraak, seekhna), beta (chusti, soch), alpha (sukoon), theta aur delta (neend). Ghair mamooli lehrein daure, mirgi ya tumour ki taraf ishara karti hain.
3. MRI (magnets aur radio waves, hydrogen atoms par) aur CT (X-ray tomography) bijli ki sargarmi record nahi karte; yeh dimagh ki banawat ki tafseeli tasveer dete hain, is liye batate hain ke ghair mamooli bijli ki wajah (tumour, stroke, chot) kahan hai.
4. Chapter se aage: functional MRI khoon ke bahao ki tabdeeli se batata hai ke dimagh ke kaun se hisse active hain, aur magnetoencephalography (MEG) bohat hassas magnetic detectors se neurons ke bijli ke current se bane nanhe magnetic fields record karta hai; yun 'magnets' se bhi bijli ki sargarmi ka naqsha banta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Farq yaad rakhein: EEG = bijli ki sargarmi (lehrein); CT aur MRI = banawat ki tasveer. Sawal 'magnets and tomography' kehta hai, magar chapter ke mutabiq yeh dono tasveer dete hain; bijli seedha EEG record karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Justify the way nervous system helps to coordinate complex and intricate movements of hand to play a piano, or write alphabets.
Sabit karein ke nervous system piano bajane ya huroof likhne jaisi pecheeda haath ki harkaton ko kaise tarteeb deta hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Receptors khabar ikattha karte hain: aankhein notes ya huroof dekhti hain; kaan aawaz sunte hain; ungliyon ke poron ke touch receptors (Meissner's corpuscles, Merkel cells) keys ya qalam mehsoos karte hain; muscles, tendons aur jorron ke receptors ungliyon ki position batate hain.
2. Sensory neurons yeh khabar CNS tak le jate hain; myelinated neurons isay tez banate hain.
3. Cerebrum mansooba banata hai: association areas aur frontal lobe faisla karte hain; parietal lobe haath ki position ka ehsas aur harkat ka mansooba aur amal; zuban ke hisse (baayen) huroof aur music parhne ka kaam.
4. Motor cortex somatic (ikhtiyari) nervous system ke motor neurons se ungliyon, haath aur baazu ke bohat se chhote skeletal muscles ko hukm bhejta hai.
5. Cerebellum muscles, tendons, jorron, aankhon aur kaanon se khabar le kar tez musalsal harkat aur posture ko tarteeb deta hai, is liye harkat hamwar aur durust hoti hai.
6. Inter-neurons aur inhibitory neurotransmitters mukhalif muscles ko dheela karte hain (jaise knee-jerk mein hamstrings), is liye har ungli theek harkat karti hai.
7. Mashq: hippocampus thori der ki yaad ko lambi yaad banata hai, is liye mashq ki hui harkat tez aur taqreeban khud ba khud ho jati hai.
8. Lagatar feedback (dekhna, sunna, chhoona) se dimagh ghalti fauran theek karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Justify that the development of a modern computer is in fact a product of the understanding of the way nervous coordination occurs in complex organisms like humans.
Sabit karein ke jadeed computer ki tarraqi dar asal insaan jaise pecheeda jandaron mein nervous coordination ki samajh ka nateeja hai.
blocks.explanation:
Computer nervous coordination ke naqshe ki naqal hai: input -> processing -> output, bijli ke signals aur yaaddasht ke saath. (Yeh muqabla aur computer ki tareekh chapter se aage hai.)
1. Jaise receptors stimulus ko impulse mein badalte hain (transducers), waise input devices keys, roshni aur aawaz ko bijli ke signals mein badalte hain.
2. Jaise neurons barabar taqat ke 'ya sab ya kuch nahi' impulses le jate hain, waise computer on/off (1/0) signals istemal karta hai.
3. Jaise synapse signal guzarta ya rokta hai (excitatory ya inhibitory), waise transistors aur logic gates signal on ya off karte hain.
4. Jaise dimagh ke inter-neurons khabar par amal karte hain, waise processor (CPU) data process karta hai; jaise hippocampus yaad jama karta hai, waise computer ki memory aur storage hai.
5. Jaise motor neurons aur effectors jawab dete hain, waise output devices (screen, printer, motors) nateeja dete hain.
6. Jadeed computers aur AI ke artificial neural networks seedhe neurons aur synapses ke jaal ki naqal hain.

rows: 'Ya sab ya kuch nahi' nerve impulses

items: MCQs ke jawab chapter ke text se: 1c 2a 3b 4c 5c 6b 7d 8c 9b 10a 11c 12a 13c 14b 15b 16b 17b.

MCQ 4 ka option (a) 'Acetylcholine' be-mail hai; MCQ 7 mein 'None of Ranvier' (durust 'Node of Ranvier'); MCQ 9 mein (b) aur (d) dono durust; short Q12 mein 'nerves system' (durust 'nervous system') ("Kitab ki ghalti" boxes).
Short Q12 ke 12 joron ka farq, long Q10 (dimagh aur spinal cord), long Q11 (sympathetic aur parasympathetic) aur inquisitive Q4 (nervous system aur computer) table mein.
Short (12), long (18) aur inquisitive (4) sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath diye gaye hain.
